contract: design-contract.json: supplied crest, exact welcome heading, inline sign-in, no signed-out app shell, stable deep links and form input.

accessibility.evidence: Browser checked skip-link keyboard navigation, visible 3px focus outline, labelled name/PIN fields, error alerts, 44px or larger interactive targets, outside-click dialog dismissal and reduced-motion rendering. Muted text is #626262 on white or #f7f7f7; action text is #262626 on #f6c744. Screen-reader and physical-device testing were not performed.

responsive.evidence: Inspected rendered desktop, mobile and narrow mobile captures. No horizontal overflow at 1440, 390 or 320px; heading and account actions wrap cleanly, with scrolling for longer forms.

loading.evidence: Delayed session response shows the crest and Checking sign-in with no app navigation (loading.png).

empty.evidence: Empty synthetic roster shows account-request guidance and keeps administrator sign-in available (empty-roster.png).

error.evidence: Incorrect PIN stays on welcome; mismatched signup PINs remain editable; failed connection offers a working Try again action (login-error.png, signup-error.png, connection-error.png).

partial.evidence: Config succeeds while state fails: no app content is mounted, and retry resolves to welcome after state recovery.

success.evidence: Valid player sign-in restores a targeted joining link, administrator sign-in opens app, existing sessions bypass welcome, and signup acknowledgement stays outside the app (signed-in-deep-link.png, signup-success.png).

permission.evidence: Direct links for every app route stay on welcome until signed in. Logout and an expired session remove the app and an open account dialog. This is a UI gate; backend data response permissions were not changed.

renderedEvidence.observation: Two-column welcome and form; supplied crest, neutral surfaces and yellow selected/action controls.
Stacked welcome and sign-in form with readable labels and no clipped controls.
Narrow screen preserves complete heading, usable form controls and wrapping secondary actions.

validation.browser: browser-results.json; synthetic data and local mock API only
validation.deployment: Not deployed. Local working tree already contained other unpublished application changes.
